LanguageData.ESCP_KingdomOfSkyrim_Enlist_Letter_Label: The colony has sworn itself to the throne in Solitude. The jarls loyal to the High King will feed and pay those who fight for Skyrim.
LanguageData.ESCP_KingdomOfSkyrim_Enlist_Button_Desc: Bend the knee in Solitude and take a place in the High King's service.
LanguageData.ESCP_KingdomOfSkyrim_Enlist_Requrements_: The jarls do not know your name well enough yet. Standing: {0}.
LanguageData.ESCP_KingdomOfSkyrim_Enlisted_To_Hostile: Solitude will not take an oath from an enemy of the crown.
LanguageData.ESCP_KingdomOfSkyrim_Missions_Desc: See what the court needs handled.
LanguageData.ESCP_KingdomOfSkyrim_Menu_Missions_Desc: Work posted by the jarl's steward. Payment is sent from the hold's treasury when it is done.
LanguageData.ESCP_KingdomOfSkyrim_Provisions_Desc: Salted meat, bread and mead from the longhouse.
LanguageData.ESCP_KingdomOfSkyrim_Storage_Desc: Leave goods with the steward and fetch them from any loyal hold.
LanguageData.ESCP_KingdomOfSkyrim_Resign_Menu_Text: Break your oath to the High King? Nords do not forget an oathbreaker.
LanguageData.ESCP_KingdomOfSkyrim_Resign_Letter_Label: The colony has gone back on its oath to the High King. The jarls have taken note.
LanguageData.ESCP_KingdomOfSkyrim_Resign_Button_Desc: Walk away from your sworn service to the crown.
LanguageData.ESCP_KingdomOfSkyrim_Kick_Out_Letter_Tit: Cast out by the High King
LanguageData.ESCP_KingdomOfSkyrim_Kick_Out_Label_Titl: Solitude no longer counts the colony among its sworn. Do not expect a welcome in the loyal holds.
LanguageData.ESCP_KingdomOfSkyrim_Salary_Desc: A thane's share from the hold treasury.
LanguageData.ESCP_KingdomOfSkyrim_Work_0_Desc: Walk the walls with the jarl's guard and keep the peace in town.
LanguageData.ESCP_KingdomOfSkyrim_Work_1_Desc: The jarl's housecarls are happy to knock some skill into anyone who asks.
